biggest_catch: You bet YOUR OWN money and there are absolutely NO refunds or cancellations — if you miss your verified weight-loss goal, you lose your entire wager. The $500 headline is not fixed: prizes are algorithm-calculated and paid ONLY if verified weigh-ins prove you hit your goal. This is conditional prize money at financial risk, never fixed income.
catches: No fixed $500 payout exists on official pages — prizes are algorithm-calculated (based on your goal, bet, timeframe, BMI); the official page shows real winner prizes ranging from $1,163 to $10,984.
You fund the wager yourself: pay in full up front or in monthly installments. Official FAQ: 'you can't quit — there are absolutely no cancellations or refunds.'
Both start and end weights require a verified video weigh-in via the app (smartphone + scale), and winners submit photo ID for identity/height confirmation.
A referee team reviews your win and certifies it within 7 days; you must maintain your weight loss through that review window.
Minimum goal is typically 10% of body weight (per official calculator flow and challenge rules) — this is a serious weight-loss commitment, not a side gig.

Health risk: rapid/unhealthy weight loss is a real danger. Get doctor clearance before attempting; pregnancy pauses your challenge; weight loss via bariatric surgery or other surgical intervention disqualifies you; weight-loss medications (incl. GLP-1s) require doctor care.
Winnings above the IRS $600 threshold are reported for taxes; HealthyWage does not withhold.
Yo-yo rule: if you previously won $200+, future challenges must start at or below your last ending weight — you cannot re-bet the same weight loss repeatedly.

eligibility: Age 18+; not pregnant (challenge suspended on reported pregnancy, doctor clearance to resume); no bariatric/surgical weight-loss intervention within the past year (disqualifies); no professional athletes, bodybuilders, or trainers; weight-loss medications only under physician care; US/UK/Canada/Latin America/Australia and most of Europe/Asia (per official challenge rules). Doctor approval recommended for any fitness program.

steps: Open the official HealthyWager page and use the prize calculator to see your algorithm-calculated prize for your goal weight, bet amount, and timeframe — there is no fixed $500; your prize is personalized.
Choose your goal (typically at least 10% of your body weight) and your wager amount; decide to pay the full amount up front or in monthly installments.
Download the HealthyWage app and complete your verified starting weigh-in: step on your scale and follow the on-screen instructions to record the short weigh-in video.
Work toward your goal within your challenge timeframe — there are no monthly milestones; only the final result matters.
In the final two weeks of your challenge (no earlier), complete your verified ending weigh-in via the app.
Submit the winner confirmation form with photo ID so HealthyWage can verify your identity and height.
Maintain your weight loss while the referee team reviews and certifies your win (within 7 days).
Receive your prize after certification — report it for taxes if above the IRS $600 threshold.
timing: Prize paid after verified final weigh-in and referee certification (within 7 days); no fixed $500 amount — prize is algorithm-calculated.
